summary: Shows testing a new module end to end with a small playbook next to the library directory that runs the module, registers the result and prints it with debug.
questions: How do I test my new module inside a playbook?
How can I see the full output my module returns?

answer_card.title: Test a module in a playbook
answer_card.answer_md:
With `library/` next to the playbook:
```yaml
- name: test my new module
  hosts: localhost
  tasks:
  - name: run the new module
    my_test:
      name: 'hello'
      new: true
    register: testout
  - name: dump test output
    debug:
      msg: '{{ testout }}'
```
Run `ansible-playbook ./testmod.yml`.
